common_missing_inputs: Claim-bearing predecessor reports and retained counterexamples before selection.

title: RAW UNREVIEWED: geometric witness satisfies two constraints rather than serving as a visited station
summary: A diagram-linked passage may introduce a constructed point as the shared witness of two relations, then use it in a consequence. Lines and intersections have typed roles rather than counted sectors or a human itinerary. Repeated parameter substitution must preserve the same construction grammar.
required_falsifier: Reject if multiple diagram witnesses remain equally eligible, one constraint is omitted from the text account, W consumes an unentered latest-location fallback, or parameter substitution requires new relation meanings.
exact_changed_research_decision: Determine whether a complete diagram record expresses a constrained geometric construction rather than an itinerary/static list; no line/point meaning is confirmed by topology alone.

design.mechanism: Enter lines or circles A,B; CONSTRUCT_WITNESS(W,A,B) binds one explicit locus constrained by both; derive relation D using W. A second complete example changes parameters but uses identical arity, order and boundary rules; W cannot silently mean the latest place.
independent_constraints: Two independently visible diagram relations identify one common witness, not merely matching number of marks.
The written construction binds both arguments before the consequence.
Rare witness wholeform and recurrent relational components have profiles compatible with construction versus statement, including initial and medial uses.
design.unit: Two complete prospective admitted contexts plus their independently owned image-role evidence; no target nomination or access by producer.
design.minimum_adequate_test: First audit claim-bearing predecessors and known counterexample; then root can choose one paired exploratory whole reading and only freeze a test if a distinct consequence remains.
design.budget_note: Root must set total preparation/implementation/validation/publication budget in the selected existing proposal before substantial work; this raw producer launches no experiment.

duplicate_navigation.important_limit: No identity reported by navigation is not proof of novelty. Raw refinement may overlap its named predecessors; root must check claim-bearing primaries before selection.
